message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as the cover for Tempo magazine, dated 21-27 JULI 2025. Against a pale-yellow background, the red masthead "TEMPO" is centered at the top. Below, the bold black title reads "RIZA CHALID, AKHIRNYA" followed by several lines of smaller Indonesian text.

The primary scene features a man with a mustache and dark hair, wearing a pink collared shirt and grey trousers. His torso is encased within a large metal oil drum, which is painted with brown and white horizontal bands. He is walking towards the right, glancing back with an angry expression. To his left, another man in a tan suit is depicted from behind, hunched over with clenched fists, appearing to walk away. 

The setting is a barren, brown landscape littered with numerous grey metal oil drums. In the background stands a grey, gabled building with a small window and a spinning roof ventilator. The horizon shows a hazy green city skyline. At the bottom left, a barcode, a QR code, and price information are visible.
